snippet.title: 1st Trailer - Co-op flight game "Over the Radio"
snippet.description:
Coming in 2026! Add to wishlist today!
Steam store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3790280/Over_the_Radio/
Website: https://overtheradio.polygoose.studio/

about this game:
Over the Radio is a local co-op communication game where two players—one Pilot, one Navigator—work together to reach the correct destination. The Pilot flies the plane on the in-game screen, while the Navigator guides using a real paper map. During the flight, neither player can see the other’s screen or map, so they must rely entirely on conversation to succeed.
Flights take place over a repeating natural landscape, giving the sense of an infinite world. Players must communicate constantly and coordinate while the plane never stops. The real paper map creates a unique tactile experience, blending analog and digital play. Inspired by the developer’s pilot training, Over the Radio offers a slightly different approach to cooperative gameplay—challenging players to rely not on reflexes, but on communication and trust.

The title has been selected as part of Selected Indie 80 and will be showcased at Tokyo Game Show 2025.
